requirements.requirement: Exact boxed integer inclusive/just-over/negative/extreme/mixed-width boundaries and dictionary input identity
Invariant textual conversion, signs/padding, fractional/exponential/overflow rejection, remaining integer widths, decimal scale, floating point, enum and Boolean fallback
Invariant provider interface dispatch and conversion exception propagation
Missing/null values, literal matching, ambient culture independence and exact argument guards
Actual Components-compiled copy preserves typed/string/null results and dictionary identity
Owning surrounding consumers and exact complete named-link producer outputs
Compatible measured targeted gain, full control/regression/raw evidence and exact immutable A/B

excluded_boundaries: HTTP-hosted workload, browser/render/navigation timing, WebAssembly timing and production throughput.
Custom route-policy overrides and culture-mutated user types beyond the exercised fallback providers.
Quantitative cause attribution for decimal control instability or non-target control apparent gains.
